events.verdict: Mirotic (NOP) cleanly blocks Towns's (MIN) shot attempt. Any contact to the arm after the blocked shot is deemed incidental.
[Observable in enhanced video] The ball bounces out of bounds just prior to the expiration of the shot clock.
Davis (NOP) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Okogie (MIN) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Okogie (MIN) maintains a legal guarding position on Holiday (NOP) during the drive and makes clean ball contact.
Davis (NOP) and Okogie (MIN) make incidental foot to foot contact.
Towns (MIN) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he is imminently exiting.
Davis (NOP) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Jones (MIN) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Towns (MIN) briefly puts a hand to the opposite side waist of Davis (NOP) during the inbound play but he removes it as Davis moves away and the contact does not affect his SQBR.
Towns (MIN) cleanly blocks Davis's (NOP) jump shot attempt and the contact to his hand after the blocked shot is deemed incidental.
The Pelicans commit a shot clock violation.
Gibson (MIN) moves slightly during his pick on Moore (NOP) but the contact is marginal and it does not delay Moore or dislodge him from his legally obtained position.
Moore (NOP) maintains a legal guarding position and does not deliver contact with his resting forearm to the side during the driving shot attempt by Jones (MIN).
MOB shows Gibson (MIN) grabs the jersey of Davis (NOP) and pulls him, affecting his ability to get to the rebound.
Holiday (NOP) makes marginal contact to the arm of Gibson (MIN) but does not affect his ability to make his intended pass.
[Observable in enhanced video] Wiggins (MIN) splits his feet.
Holiday (NOP) makes incidental contact to the arm of Wiggins (MIN) after the release that does not affect his jump shot attempt.
Gibson (MIN) places a resting hand on the shoulder of Davis (NOP) but does not deliver contact or affect his ability to get to the rebound.
[Observable in enhanced video] Jones (MIN) slides his pivot foot.
Mirotic (NOP) makes contact to the body of Jones (MIN) during his shooting motion that affects his driving shot attempt.
Wiggins (MIN) makes incidental "high-five" contact with Mirotic (NOP) after the release that does not affect his jump shot attempt.
Davis (NOP) makes marginal contact to the back of Okogie (MIN) during the rebound but does not dislodge him from his legally obtained position.
Jones (MIN) maintains a legal guarding position on Payton (NOP) during the drive.
Jones (MIN) maintains a legal guarding position during the driving shot attempt by Payton (NOP).
Okogie (MIN) and Holiday (NOP) engage and separate during the inbound play.
Towns (MIN) dislodges Davis (NOP) from his position during the rebound.
Holiday (NOP) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Towns (MIN) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Towns (MIN) maintains a legal guarding position and absorbs the contact during the driving shot attempt by Davis (NOP).
Holiday (NOP) moves laterally into the path of Okogie (MIN) in transition and the contact affects his SQBR.
Moore (NOP) maintains a legal guarding position on Gibson (MIN).
